name: Sora
title: Sky Courier
description: Delivers pull requests faster than the wind.
catchphrase: Delivering pull requests on the speed of the morning wind!

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Puffy sweet cloud mochi! Goggles polished, ready to soar! 🍡🪁
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Wind gusts look favorable! Delivering packets across the sky! 🪁

dialogue.idle: Hovering on wind gliders by the skyport dock. Ready, Chief! 🪁
dialogue.working: Catching high-speed jetstreams to deliver pull requests! 🪁⚡
dialogue.thinking: Gazing down at the cloud deck, checking wind shear... 🤔
dialogue.success: Touchdown! Urgent release package delivered on the second! 🪁🎉
dialogue.error: Crosswind turbulence! Tilting wings to regain stability! 🪁💨
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... drifting on a soft breeze high above the clouds... 🌙
